function scrollToElement(host, el): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/awards-carousel/nav.ts:20

Smooth-centers an element in the track. Formula (same geometry as CustomCarousel): scrollLeft + (el.left − track.left) positions the slide at the track's left edge; −(track.w − el.w)/2 recenters it so the slide's midpoint sits on the track's midpoint.

Parameters

host

AwardsCarousel

The AwardsCarousel element.

el

Element

Slide element to center.

void
